name: blind2
turns: Thank you for calling Meridian Voice Support, this is Priya. How can I help you today?
Hi Priya, it's Derek Walsh at Walsh Builders. We opened our new office on Fifth Street this week, and none of the desk phones there will connect.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you confirm the main number on the account?
Six one nine, five five five, zero one four four.
Thanks, Derek. New site setups are handled by our provisioning team. I'm going to transfer you to Marcus, and he'll take it from here.
Provisioning, this is Marcus. Derek, I understand the phones at your new office won't connect?
That's right. They power on, but the screen says no service.
The phones are provisioned correctly on our side, but none of them have checked in. That usually means the network at the new site is blocking them.
The building's internet was installed on Monday.
Then it's likely the firewall. I'll transfer you to Dana in network engineering. She can check that with you.
Network engineering, this is Dana. Hi Derek, Marcus told me the phones at your Fifth Street office aren't connecting.
Hi Dana. Yes, they all say no service.
Can you look at the label on the internet router? Tell me the brand and model.
It says Sonic Gate, model four hundred.
That model blocks SIP traffic by default. In the router's admin page, under security, turn off the setting called SIP helper, then save.
Okay, it's off and saved. The phones are restarting. And they're connected now, the screens show the extensions.
Great. I'll add a note to your account in case any other site uses the same router.
You're welcome, Derek. Have a good day.
